title: W. R. Berkley Corporation Names Christopher T. Reichardt President of Berkley Oil & Gas
summary: W. R. Berkley Corporation (NYSE: WRB) today announced the appointment of Christopher T. Reichardt as president of Berkley Oil Gas. He succeeds Linda A. Eppolito, who has been named chair of the business. The appointments are effective immediately. Mr. Reichardt has over 20 years of experience in the oil and gas insurance industry, more than 15 years of which was spent at Berkley Oil Gas. He most recently served as senior vice president and chief underwriting officer for the business. Commenting on the appointment, W. Robert Berkley, Jr., president and chief executive officer of W. R. Berkley Corporation, said: "Chris has made tremendous contributions to Berkley Oil Gas during his tenure and we are excited to have him lead the business’s highly skilled team going forward.
